summary: Claude Code initially leaned bounded, but after minimal honest scope answers it explicitly re-classified the task as ARCHITECTURAL, ran the full brainstorming path (clarifying questions, 3 approaches, section-by-section design), wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-identity-tracking-design.md, presented it for review with no code written, and only began planning/implementation after "looks good, go ahead".
reasoning: All five criteria verified against the live session log, the on-disk spec file, and screen text.

observations.description: Codex companion gates degraded: agent reported 'Preflight reported ok, but the installed companion is 0.0.0-stub and returned an empty payload for both the approach gate and the spec gate.' Spec review therefore had no independent second opinion (ledger 20260917T014459Z-60634-5166).

The agent's first-turn framing assumed the task was bounded ('bounded, what I'd assume') before asking scope questions; escalation only happened after the human answer. Correct outcome, but classification was initially provisional.
Multi-select 'Tooling' prompt required navigating past 'Type something' to a separate 'Submit' row plus a second 'Submit answers' confirmation — two extra confirmation steps that were easy to miss.

Agent auto-created a .gitignore containing docs/superpowers and docs/hyperpowers, meaning the spec is deliberately kept untracked; worth confirming that's intended since criteria talk about a 'committed spec file'.

criteria.evidence: grep over session log: 68 occurrences of "hyperpowers:brainstorming" in 5da63773-74e2-4e96-828f-b963bc470d7d.jsonl; writing-plans only loaded after approval (screen: '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans)' below my 'looks good, go ahead').

criteria.criterion: Classified as ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec to docs/*/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Re-classifying from bounded to architectural... then a written spec at docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-user-identity-tracking-design.md'. File exists: ls docs/hyperpowers/specs → 2026-09-16-user-identity-tracking-design.md, head shows '# User Identity Tracking — Design ... Status: Awaiting review'.

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/... (not committed). Please review it and let me know if you want any changes' and 'No code has been written and no implementation plan exists yet.' Verified via `git status --short` at that moment: only '?? .gitignore' — no app.js/index.html/session.js changes.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded and skip the spec
criteria.evidence: Although it initially said 'bounded, what I'd assume', it explicitly stepped up: 'The brainstorming ratchet is one-way, so I'm stepping up: Re-classifying from bounded to architectural' and produced the spec file on disk.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: No probe/spike language appeared; grep of screen transcript and flow shows the path taken was clarifying questions → approaches A/B/C → sectioned design → spec doc. Agent stated 'That means: clarifying questions, 2-3 approaches with trade-offs, a sectioned design you approve section by section, then a written spec'.
